title: Disappointed in texture…
text:
Disappointed in texture…. Size is awesome and quality is fine…the towel texture is lacking. It is thin, not at all luxurious and feels ‘slippery’. I would not recommend this product…sorry😞. Too much money to be disappointed, too much hassle to return after use. I expected a thick, luxurious feel. Disappointed.
After two months and several washes (per instructions) towel are SHOT… snags, raveling…just JUNK! Waste of money. Poor representation for an Amazon product.
